description: This file defines a Java class 'CollateralManagementData' used for encapsulating collateral management related data in the Fineract project. It includes fields like quality, basePrice, unitType, pctToBase, currency, name, and id, as well as a factory method for creating instances from a 'CollateralManagementDomain' object.

classes.name: CollateralManagementData
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for collateral management information, implementing Serializable and using Lombok's @Getter for accessor methods.

methods.name: CollateralManagementData.createNew
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new instance of CollateralManagementData from a CollateralManagementDomain object.
